note: Topic brief required covering the Purview Information Protection admin program (taxonomy/priority order, auto-labeling policies, the Fabric tenant toggle, protection actions vs. classification-only labels, and tenant-wide classification reporting) without repeating Lesson 13's end-user label-picker content. Four real, on-topic screenshots were found directly in Microsoft's own sensitivity-labels / auto-labeling documentation (exceeding the 3-screenshot floor), all verified via curl -sI for Content-Type: image/png and viewed with the Read tool before captioning. Two gaps, documented honestly rather than papered over with an unrelated image: (1) the Fabric admin portal's 'Allow users to apply sensitivity labels for Power BI content' tenant toggle itself has no screenshot in the Fabric admin docs (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/admin/service-admin-portal-information-protection) — that page's only image shows a downstream sharing-link consequence, not the toggle switch, so this setting is covered as a 'steps' slide instead; (2) the Purview data-classification / content-explorer / activity-explorer overview pages are text-only reference articles with no embedded screenshots as of this date, so tenant-wide classification reporting is also covered as a 'steps' slide. The label/policy priority mechanics (highest-priority-number wins for both labels and policies) were cross-checked word-for-word against the 'Label priority (order matters)' and 'Publish sensitivity labels...' sections of learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/sensitivity-labels before writing the guide and script.
